Himanshu Singh @ Golu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 3 November, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131577026/
1

G.A. 
 Court No. - 51
 Hon'Ble Raj Beer Singh, J. 
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material
brought on record.

2.  The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.56 of 2021, under Sections 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Naugarh, District- Chandauli with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.

The first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 19.02.2024.
3.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
As per prosecution version, the alleged incident took place on 30.04.2021 but first information report was lodged with long delay on 10.08.2021.
At the time of hearing of first bail application of applicant, there was no DNA report but now the DNA report has been received.
As per DNA report, there is no evidence that applicant was involved in commission of rape upon victim.
Further, the period of pregnancy of victim does not correlate with the date of incident of alleged rape.
It is further submitted that statement of victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C.

was not recorded properly and the incriminating material against the applicant was mentioned by way of getting it written from victim, whereas some other facts were mentioned on the basis of statement of expert.

The applicant is in jail since 15.08.2021 and that during trial only two witnesses have been examined.
4. Learned counsel submitted that in fact both the parties are neighbours and the parents of victim girl wanted to marry the victim with applicant and when he refused, he was falsely implicated in this case.

The applicant has no criminal history and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that victim is a 14 years old deaf and dumb girl and due to rape committed upon victim, she has become pregnant.
It was stated that victim has supported prosecution version during trial.

6. I have considered rival submissions and perused the record.
7.
Perusal of record shows that victim is a 14 years old deaf and dumb girl and she has made allegations that applicant has committed rape upon her.
Due to alleged rape, she has suffered pregnancy.
During trial, she has made statement against applicant.
It was also mentioned that applicant is uncle of victim girl.

sentences.text: 8. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, no case for bail is made out.
9. The bail application of applicant is rejected.
10. However, considering period of detention of applicant, the trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and to conclude the same as early as possible, preferably within a period of nine months.
11. With the aforesaid observations, the bail application is hereby dismissed.

(Raj Beer Singh,J.) November 3, 2025 'SP'/-
